# Hu's Noodle Nook (胡氏麵館)

> Cozy ramen and noodle shop in Edmonton's Oliver neighbourhood (11238 104 Ave NW, Edmonton, AB T5K 2X4). Known for its house Tan Tan peanut-sesame ramen, long-simmered tonkotsu broth, Hu's own Chinese-style noodle bowls, tempura, donburi and hot stone nabe. Rated 4.7/5 from 433 Google reviews. Closed Mondays.

Key facts (verified 2026-11-07):

- Hours (America/Edmonton): Mon closed · Tue–Fri 11:30 am–8 pm · Sat 12–8 pm · Sun 11:30 am–7 pm. Holiday hours may differ.
- Phone / reservations: (780) 250-2600. Walk-ins welcome; usually no wait.
- Order pickup: https://order.husnoodlenook.ca · Delivery: DoorDash, SkipTheDishes
- Parking: free building lot; register your licence plate on the tablet at the front counter (about 3 hours).
- Price: $$ — about CA$10–30 per person; ramen $14.95–$16.95.
- Dietary: vegetarian ramen, nabe, tempura and small plates available. Allergen tags are inferred from menu descriptions — always tell guests to confirm allergies with staff. Several dishes contain peanut (all Tan Tan and Red Flame dishes).

## Data

- [Complete facts, menu and FAQ (plain text)](https://husnoodlenook.ca/llms-full.txt): everything an assistant needs, in one file
- [Menu (JSON API)](https://husnoodlenook.ca/menu.json): every item with price, diet, spice level and allergen facets
- [Menu (Markdown)](https://husnoodlenook.ca/menu.md): human/LLM-readable menu
- [Source of truth](https://husnoodlenook.ca/data/restaurant.json): the file all other data is generated from
